config.title: AI DeskPet
config.pet.name.description: Pet name, shown in chat bubbles and prompts.
config.pet.modelPath.description: Avatar file path (absolute or relative to the workspace root). For Live2D, point to .model3.json / .model.json.
config.pet.cubismCorePath.description: Path to the Live2D Cubism Core file (live2dcubismcore.min.js). Provided by Live2D; not bundled.
config.pet.tts.description: Read replies aloud using system speech synthesis.
config.pet.showOnStartup.description: Open the DeskPet sidebar on startup.
config.pet.breakReminderMinutes.descript: Remind you to rest after this many minutes of coding; 0 disables it.
config.pet.reactOnSave.description: React when you save a file.
config.pet.reactOnError.description: Warn you when the code has errors.
config.pet.interruption.enum.0: Quiet: reminders go to chat only, never pop a bubble
config.pet.interruption.enum.1: Balanced: only important reminders pop up; stay silent while typing
config.pet.interruption.enum.2: Chatty: every reminder pops a bubble
config.teach.depth.enum.0: Line by line: explain each line by number
config.teach.depth.enum.1: Logic walkthrough: steps in execution order
config.teach.depth.enum.2: Design: why it works this way and how to extend it
config.ai.provider.enum.1: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI / DeepSeek / Qwen / vLLM…)
config.ai.provider.enum.2: VS Code Language Model API (reuses your Copilot subscription)
config.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (include /v1).
config.ai.extraInstructions.description: Extra persona or habits appended to the system prompt.
config.docs.searchProvider.description: Web search service used for docs lookup.
config.docs.searchProvider.enum.0: No web search; only fetch the given doc URLs
config.context.enabled.description: Enable project context: index the repo and attach related modules, definitions, and conventions to each question.
config.context.maxFiles.description: Maximum files to index (ordered by VS Code search). Raise it for large repos.
config.context.maxChars.description: Maximum characters of project context per question. Use 4000–6000 for small context windows.
config.fix.autoDiff.description: Open a side-by-side diff when generating a fix.
config.fix.maxAutoDiagnostics.descriptio: Maximum errors handled by “Fix all errors in this file”.
config.verify.afterEdit.description: After applying an AI edit, wait for diagnostics and offer undo or another fix if new errors appear.
config.verify.dependents.description: Also verify up to 4 files that depend on the edited file.
config.rewrite.maxLines.description: Maximum lines for a full-file rewrite (after the model passes the capability check).
config.rewrite.maxChars.description: Maximum characters for a full-file rewrite (after the capability check).
config.debug.watchTerminal.description: Capture failed terminal commands (requires VS Code 1.93+ Shell Integration) for error analysis.
config.standards.packs.description: Enabled rule packs. Added to every generation prompt and used for local scans.
config.standards.custom.description: Custom team rules added to every generation prompt.
config.standards.custom.guidance.descrip: Guidance for the model; be specific
config.standards.custom.languages.descri: Limit to language ids; empty means all
config.standards.whitelist.description: Scan whitelist: matching rules are not reported in these files and the model won’t “fix” them.
config.standards.whitelist.rule.descript: Rule id; prefixes like security.* are supported
config.standards.whitelist.glob.descript: File glob, e.g. **/test/**; empty means all files
config.standards.whitelist.reason.descri: Why it is exempt (shown to the model)
config.style.indent.description: Indentation for generated code. auto follows the current file.
config.style.quotes.description: Quote style for generated code. auto follows the current file.
config.style.semicolons.description: Semicolons in generated code. auto follows the current file.
config.inline.codeLens.description: Show Explain / Refactor CodeLens above each function or method.
config.ui.language.description: Language for the DeskPet panel and AI replies.
config.ui.language.enum.0: Follow the VS Code display language
config.ui.theme.description: Color palette for the DeskPet panel.
config.ui.theme.enum.0: Follow the VS Code accent color
config.ui.motion.enum.1: Disable idle animations such as breathing
config.ui.nameplate.description: Show a name · mood plate below the avatar.
config.ui.quickActions.description: Quick action buttons. Leave empty for the built-in set.
config.ui.quickActions.command.descripti: Command id to run on click
config.ui.quickActions.text.description: Text to send on click; use __docs__ for docs mode
config.ui.customCss.description: Custom CSS for the DeskPet webview (panel only, max 12000 characters).
config.pet.userName.description: What the pet calls you. Empty means “you”.
config.pet.greeting.description: Greeting shown the first time the panel opens. Empty uses the default.
